question: Should grouped Claw updates intentionally permit installed package artifacts to remain when a later owner or provenance step fails?
rationale: The implementation deliberately reports this as partial state, but accepting the resulting operator recovery burden is a lifecycle product decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Accept explicit partial state
options.body: Permit retained artifacts only with reliable status, diagnostics, and documented recovery guidance.

options.title: Require artifact rollback
options.body: Keep package update actions blocked until newly installed artifacts can be reversed.

options.title: Defer package updates
options.body: Land the reversible owner updates while leaving package changes as manual actions.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit partial state
recommendation.body: Permit retained artifacts only with reliable status, diagnostics, and documented recovery guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the broadest adjacent ownership across CLI, package installation, configuration, and gateway lifecycle behavior.
